description: This schema describes the identifying information required for every dataset.

documentType.description: A string describing this dataset's category.

datasetName.description: The title given to a dataset by an evaluator.  Typical examples might be '\$^{148}\$Gd \$\\alpha\$ decay' or (HI,\$xn\gamma\$).

database.description: Indicates from which NNDC database this dataset originates.

drawingOptions.description: This is an instruction that evaluators can use to control the figures in Nuclear Data Sheets.
